scope: CVG-003 account-aware prescription detail, document, revision and command boundary with authenticated route propagation

criteria.description: Prescription detail, document, revision, update, archive and sign operations require explicit account scope and fail closed before disclosure or mutation.
criteria.limitations: The proof covers the reviewed reusable service surface; future direct callers must use the explicit account-aware contract.

criteria.description: Repository hydration filters rows by requested account before cache, revision or signature publication, including contaminated repository results.
criteria.limitations: Repository SQL and target RLS were intentionally excluded; this gate accepts the application-level filtering correction only.

criteria.description: Authenticated prescription routes and reviewed first-party callers forward the authoritative principal account directly into the scoped service boundary.
criteria.limitations: Only reviewed repository-local first-party callers are covered; no claim is made for future consumers.

criteria.description: Focused, route, authenticated PostgreSQL HTTP and canonical runtime regressions pass with changed-service coverage above the 80% bar.
criteria.limitations: Local verification does not certify remote CI, target, production, disaster recovery, distributed operation or release readiness.

criteria.description: Workspace quality/security/static controls and the official critical base/process gates pass after the bounded correction.
criteria.limitations: The critical suite and static controls remain repository-local; target, production, remote CI and release controls remain outside this child.

criteria.description: A fresh independent read-only review returned APPROVE_BOUNDED with no actionable in-scope correctness or security finding.
criteria.limitations: The review is bounded to the changed service, route, hydration and regression evidence and does not replace target or production assurance.

criteria.description: The child is closed without promoting CVG-003, global ERP readiness, Vetus parity, providers, target operations, production, deployment, release or unrelated modules.
criteria.limitations: Global ERP remains IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion remains BLOCKED.

gaps: Repository SQL/RLS, target PostgreSQL/Redis, providers, production, remote CI, backup/restore, cutover, Vetus parity and release evidence remain open.
The test-only incompatible-index fixture correction is bounded to the critical integration baseline and is not a production invariant change.
The global ERP remains IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and is not promoted by this child gate.
conditions: Keep all reviewed prescription callers on the explicit account-aware contract.
Do not expand this gate into schema, migration, RLS, repository SQL, provider, target, production, deployment, release or global promotion work without fresh authority.
Keep global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via fresh residual scouting after the critical baseline closure
authority.scope: Repository-local account-aware prescription detail and command boundary
authority.decision: Authorize only account-first service methods, cache hydration filtering, authenticated route/first-party propagation and focused regressions; preserve existing business semantics and exclude schema, SQL, target, production and global promotion.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing any production contract, schema, migration, repository SQL, target, deployment or release behavior.

next_action: Keep the bounded source, test and control-plane changes uncommitted unless the repository owner explicitly requests a commit; resume fresh residual scouting under a new authority, preserving global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
revalidation_triggers: Changing prescription schema, migrations, RLS or repository SQL
Expanding account-aware enforcement to prescription execution or another clinical aggregate
Adding arbitrary external or in-process prescription service consumers
Changing providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, release or global ERP promotion
